messages:
Priya (Finance): @channel Heads-up: on 2026-06-15 we'll switch from the current floating free-credit slab to a fixed monthly allocation. Annual credit total unchanged; credits will be split evenly across months.

Priya (Finance): Short rationale: reduces unexpected prorates and simplifies forecasting for Dedicated and hosted accounts.

Marco (Billing): Migration mechanics: monthly = round(annual_total/12), cents/leftover go to first month. We'll emit invoice.credit_migration.v1 at cutover.

Marco (Billing): Data request -> run preview job and produce CSV of accounts where new_monthly_alloc differs by >40% from median usage. Include rollback_eligible and burst_risk_score. Due 2026-05-20.

Tess (Product): Comms: 2-week banner + email, console preview simulator, opt-in early migration for beta. Draft text below.

Aisha (Support): Support playbook: escalate >15% cost change to #billing-escalations. If within 14 days post-cutover, open rollback workflow.

Darren (Legal): Rollback = one-time per account, requires digital sign-off. Sales must approve exceptions affecting reservations.

Priya (Finance): Cushion: a 30% transient credit (invoice credit) auto-applies for two cycles for accounts marked burst-risk.

ops-billing-bot: queued_email:5871 scheduled 2026-06-01T08:00:00Z

Tess (Product): Console preview snippet:

``
From 15 June 2026 weconvert annual free credits into a predictable monthly allocation. Preview your converted monthly credit and estimated invoice impact. Opt into early migration or request rollback within 14 days after cutover.
``

Priya (Finance): Timeline: 2026-05-20 preview CSV -> teams; 2026-06-01 banner + emails; 2026-06-15 cutover; 14-day rollback window. Safety: if >0.5% of active accounts request rollback in 48h, pause rollout 24h.

Aisha (Support): I'll run training on 2026-06-03.

Marco (Billing): Sample reply for support:

"Hi <customer>, we migrated free credits to fixed monthly allocations on 15 Jun. If you'd like, we can open a rollback request (14-day window). Please share last 3 months' usage. — Marco"

Priya (Finance): Action items: Marco -> CSV by 2026-05-20; Eng -> preview API + widget by 2026-06-01; Support -> training and rollback form by 2026-06-03; Legal -> final email copy by 2026-05-22.

ops-billing-bot: migration_preview_job: completed (rows:1243) -> /migrations/2026-05-preview-2965432100.csv
